hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/santee/camping ('Each site is packed sand and has individual water and electrical hookups'; '50 Amp Service Sites: 48 sites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Two campgrounds: Cypress View (50 sites, west side) and Lakeshore (108 sites, east side). The park lists 146 standard water/electric sites (48 with 50-amp) and 10 tent sites, plus a primitive group area. Packed-sand sites; many take RVs up to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/santee/camping ('The 50-site Cypress View Campground ... The Lakeshore Campground, with 108 sites'; 'Many sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/santee/camping ('restroom facilities with hot showers'; Dump Station: Yes), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; AWH booked a single Wednesday night here by calling the park within a week of arrival (firsthand, 2026-10-01 registry note). Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park (803-854-2408). Campers with a reservation go straight to their site; staff check them in on patrol.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/santee/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/santee/campsites (policies: 'up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site'), read 2026-10-20; single-night waiver from AWH's firsthand account in the state:SC row

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added 50-amp electric + water at every site, 158 sites up to 40 ft in two campgrounds, 14-night max, showers and dump station. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Not stated: sewer, season dates (park open year-round, campground not stated), pull-throughs.
